title: Viettel Cloud
overview: Self-service IAM portal enabling 500+ internal teams to provision and manage cloud infrastructure (compute, networking, Kubernetes clusters) with zero-downtime deployments and real-time monitoring integration.
challenge: Build unified cloud console supporting multi-tenant RBAC with fine-grained access control at project and resource levels, integrating with enterprise SSO while enabling rapid feature rollouts without downtime.
contributions: Developed Cloud Console (Nuxt.js) — self-service IAM portal for infrastructure provisioning: Compute/Servers, Kubernetes clusters, Networking, Monitoring with real-time status updates.
Implemented multi-tenant RBAC: role/permission scoping at project and resource level, integrated with enterprise SSO (SAML/OAuth) for centralized authentication and audit logging.

Designed config-driven, modular architecture decoupling feature flags, resource limits, and UI theming from source code — enabling configuration updates without redeployment (Infrastructure-as-Code pattern).
Integrated observability dashboard: embedded Prometheus/Grafana metrics directly in console for real-time resource usage, health status, cost tracking, and alerting.
Set up GitLab CI/CD pipelines: containerized services with Docker, implemented blue-green deployments for zero-downtime updates, coordinated multi-service releases with infrastructure team.
Built responsive UI supporting both web and mobile (tablet) access for on-call engineers managing infrastructure from anywhere.
